description: This file is a shell script used for testing git reset behavior in bare and non-bare repositories. It contains setup commands, test cases, and assertions related to git reset operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, containing commands to execute the test.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files to expected content.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
